items.title: Miami Flight Delays Mount After Amazon Incident
items.summary: Flights leaving and arriving at Miami International Airport are delayed after an Amazon cargo flight had overrun the runway after landing there in the afternoon.  "We can confirm that an Amazon Air plane operated by 21 Air experienced an incident while attempting to land at Miami International Airport today," Amazon spokesperson Kelly Nantel said in an email.  A post on X by the Miami-Dade Fire Rescue said units were on the scene of an incident involving a plane that overran the runway and struck multiple vehicles near the airport.
